signal: Advanced Solutions International (ASI) saw iMIS named to G2's 2026 Best Software Awards and is exhibiting at ASAE MMC+Tech 2026, driving association-market demand.

email.body1:
Jim, saw iMIS landed on G2's 2026 Best Software Awards and ASI is exhibiting at ASAE's MMC+Tech 2026.

That kind of recognition and event motion usually surfaces more association accounts than an inside team can work before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jim, quick follow-up for ASI.

Awards and conferences fill the top of funnel, but most inside teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert that interest. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your inside team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jim, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to other association software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jim, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling inside-sales coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Conference season is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an inside-sales motion? I'll tailor it to ASI either way.
